feed.title: Chen Yang — Research and Product Updates
feed.subtitle: Recent research, publications, and 3D intelligence product updates from Chen Yang.

entry.title: SCULPT: Subtractive Composition for 3D Part Generation
entry.summary: SCULPT introduces subtractive composition in a structured 3D latent space to generate adaptive, editable, part-aware 3D assets with consistent shared boundaries.

entry.title: Pixel Artisan PRO surpasses 40,000 users
entry.summary: Pixel Artisan PRO surpassed 40,000 users within 50 hours of launch, bringing 3D creation capabilities to a broad user community.

entry.title: Xiaoyi 3D and Pixel Artisan PRO launch at HDC 2026
entry.summary: Xiaoyi 3D and Pixel Artisan PRO launched at HDC 2026 and received the HarmonyOS Innovative Premium App Award.

entry.title: Snap-Snap accepted to TCSVT
entry.summary: Snap-Snap was accepted to IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology.

entry.title: TIGON: Text-Image Conditioned 3D Generation
entry.summary: TIGON uses text-image conditions and multimodal guidance to improve controllable 3D generation while preserving geometric and appearance quality.

entry.title: TIGON accepted to CVPR 2026
entry.summary: TIGON was accepted to the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026.

entry.title: UniLat3D accepted to Findings of CVPR 2026
entry.summary: UniLat3D was accepted to Findings of CVPR 2026 for its unified geometry-appearance latent representation and single-stage 3D generation framework.

entry.title: WorldGrow Gallery goes online
entry.summary: The WorldGrow Gallery is now online, showcasing examples of coherent, infinitely extendable 3D world generation.

entry.title: WorldGrow accepted as an Oral presentation at AAAI 2026
entry.summary: WorldGrow was accepted as an Oral presentation at the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence 2026.

entry.title: WorldGrow: Generating Infinite 3D World
entry.summary: WorldGrow extends coherent 3D scenes block by block using structured 3D priors, context-aware inpainting, and coarse-to-fine synthesis for open-ended world generation.

entry.title: UniLat3D: Geometry-Appearance Unified Latents for Single-Stage 3D Generation
entry.summary: UniLat3D unifies geometry and appearance in a shared latent representation, enabling single-stage 3D generation with a simple and efficient generative process.

entry.title: GaussianObject surpasses 1,200 GitHub stars
entry.summary: GaussianObject surpassed 1,200 GitHub stars, reflecting continued interest in sparse-view 3D object reconstruction with Gaussian splatting.

entry.title: GaussianObject: High-Quality 3D Object Reconstruction from Four Views with Gaussian Splatting
entry.summary: GaussianObject reconstructs high-quality 3D objects from four views with Gaussian splatting, geometric initialization, floater elimination, and diffusion-based completion.
